---
title: "Exposome phytochemicals"
subtitle: "Muscle regeneration, aging and senescence"
---

Environmental exposures can alter metabolic state and tissue function long before disease becomes
clinically apparent. We study selected phytochemicals as defined components of the exposome and ask
how they influence cellular stress responses, metabolism and muscle repair.

## Current research

Current studies use the identifier **phytochemical K01**. Its chemical identity, mechanistic claims
and development details are not disclosed while intellectual-property work is in progress.
